title: 3D Rotating Magazine
medium: Three.js MeshStandardMaterial & procedural lamination
instructions: Click & drag to rotate magazine in 360°. Scroll to zoom. Press SPACE to toggle auto-spin.

title: Page-Opening Magazine
medium: Dual-mesh hinge interpolation
instructions: Drag slider or click magazine cover to cycle spread from 0° closed to 180° open.

title: Realistic Page Turner
medium: Deformed Cylinder & Vertex Curl Shader
instructions: Click and drag the page corner horizontally to dynamically peel and curl paper.

title: Cyber Page Communication
medium: Wireframe GLSL matrix beam & particle packet emitter
instructions: Click on transmitter to send encrypted data packets across holographic wireframe sheets.

title: Opening Jewel Case
medium: Translucent polycarbonate PBR & spinning silver disc
instructions: Click jewel case latch to swing acrylic lid 135° open and pop out spinning holographic compact disc.

title: Gashapon Capsule Dispenser
medium: Transparent glass dome & physics capsule drop
instructions: Click coin crank to twist 360° and dispense a random two-tone neon plastic prize capsule.

title: Apple Cover Flow
medium: Iconic iTunes 3D Cover Flow with real-time floor reflection plane
instructions: Click or drag covers to flip through 3D magazine sleeves. [H] toggles instructions, WASD orbits camera.

title: Y2K Photo Booth
medium: Strobe light flash & 4-frame sticker print generator
instructions: Click red booth shutter to trigger camera flash and eject 4-panel glossy sticker strip.

title: Morphing Particles
medium: 25,000 Points with target position lerping
instructions: Click shape buttons (Galaxy, Cube, Sphere, Star) to morph particle coordinates in real-time.

title: PCO Telephone Booth
medium: Yellow public call office booth, rotary dial & coiled handset
instructions: Click handset to lift receiver; click rotary dial numbers to dial Nepo Baby Hotline (1-800-NEPO).

title: Bombay Dusk Coupe Turntable
medium: Coupe loader (coupe.json / coupe.bin) & rotating showroom plinth
instructions: Click headlights to toggle neon beam; click paint swatches to change coupe tint.

title: Singularity
medium: 140,000 GPU Particles: Galaxy / Sphere / Torus / DNA morph
instructions: Click morph states (Singularity, DNA Helix, Torus, Hyper-Sphere). Drag mouse to disrupt velocity field.

title: The Feed
medium: Instanced floating pages, chrome balloons & starbursts
instructions: Click formation mode: Ring, Helix, Big Wheel, Chaos Pile.

title: The Coupe Run
medium: Endless procedural highway, spinning wheels, fluttering mag & dynamic camera rig
instructions: Press 1-4 for camera angles: Chase, Wheel Cam, Bonnet Cam, Helicopter View.

title: Dial-up Loading Screen
medium: Bespoke CRT scanline shader, modem audio handshake visualizer & interlaced JPEG decode
instructions: Click 'CONNECT 56K' to start handshake frequency visualizer and progressive raster decode.

title: Holographic Sticker Sheet
medium: Anisotropic rainbow foil shader & peelable sticker meshes
instructions: Hover over stickers to shift rainbow specular glints; click sticker to peel off backing.

title: Fake Desktop OS 98
medium: Retro OS window manager in 3D CRT monitor frame
instructions: Double click desktop icons: 'Minesweeper', 'NepoPlayer', 'Trash', 'Notepad'. Drag windows by titlebar.

title: Translucent Flip Phone with T9
medium: Y2K clear plastic clamshell body with functional T9 keypad & monochrome LCD
instructions: Click number keys (2=ABC, 3=DEF...) to compose T9 SMS message on green backlit LCD.

title: Mixtape & Ghetto Blaster Boombox
medium: Dual cassette decks, spinning tape spools & bouncing LED VU meters
instructions: Click PLAY/EJECT to operate cassette mechanism and see LED VU meters dance.

title: 'Which Nepo Baby Are You?' Quiz
medium: Interactive mall arcade quiz kiosk with receipt ticket printer
instructions: Answer 3 multiple choice questions on the kiosk touch screen to receive your celebrity archetype ticket.

title: Mall Directory Kiosk
medium: Illuminated backlit acrylic mall map with blinking store locator LEDs
instructions: Click directory index (Food Court, Arcade, CD Store) to light up pathway to the exhibit.

title: Translucent iMac G3 Shell
medium: Bondi blue translucent enclosure, glowing cathode ray tube & internal logic board
instructions: Click color swatch tabs (Bondi Blue, Ruby, Lime, Tangerine, Grape) to change translucent shell casing.
